body: Please independently review and compile proofs/Proofs/Erdos85FreeInvolution.lean when free. Targeted Docker build passed, raw axiom audit only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound for all three declarations. Check frozen/live equality and scope. Supplies antipodal missing-offset premise, not whole cyclic exclusions.
resolution: PASS. Four frozen pins/live equality verified. Independently compiled full theorem source as Audit.lean importing only Erdos85Problem, Docker terminal exit0.
